prompt: Sharpless asymmetric epoxidation (conceptual): (E)-2-buten-1-ol + Ti(OiPr)4, (+)-DET, tBuOOH. Draw the (2S,3S)-epoxy alcohol product.
explanation: Sharpless uses a chiral Ti/tartrate catalyst to epoxidize allylic alcohols with high enantioselectivity. (+)-DET delivers O to one face, (-)-DET to the other. Only works on allylic alcohols (the OH coordinates to Ti to deliver asymmetric selectivity).
